Title: Users may be unable to join calls or meetings in Microsoft Teams for Mac

User impact: Users may be unable to join calls or meetings in Microsoft Teams for Mac. 

Current status: We've identified a code change that's causing the service infrastructure responsible for call and meeting functionality to fail to process some requests, resulting in impact. We're assessing potential remediation actions to address the problematic code change and restore service functionality.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to join calls or meetings in Microsoft Teams for Mac may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Thursday, July 2, 2026, at 3:09 PM UTC

Root cause: A code change is causing the service infrastructure responsible for call and meeting functionality to fail to process some requests, resulting in impact.
